_comment: Test files excluded from collection, with the measured reason for each. This list may only SHRINK. scripts/check_test_quarantine.py fails when a NEW file is quarantined, and ALSO fails when a listed file starts passing -- so a fixed file must be deleted from here rather than lingering as permanent amnesty. Same shape as scripts/schema_contract_baseline.json.
_origin: All 16 files were quarantined in one commit on 2026-05-23 (#362, 'working test infrastructure + pre-push hook + CI') -- the same commit that turned the gates ON. Getting a green baseline meant exempting everything that failed, and nothing ever forced a re-check. Re-measured 2026-08-09 against the live database: 5 files passed with no changes at all (35 tests) and were released. Two more were broken BY the quarantining itself; fixing the import order released a SIXTH file (test_conveyancing_integration.py, 8 passed) -- found by the ratchet on its very first run, which is the behaviour this file exists for.
_how_to_clear_an_entry: Fix the test, run scripts/check_test_quarantine.py, and it will tell you the entry is now passing and must be deleted from this file.

entries.measured: 12 skipped without DATABASE_URL; WITH one, 12 failed on TypeError MagicMock vs int (2026-08-09)
entries.error: TypeError: '>' not supported between instances of 'MagicMock' and 'int'
entries.cause: Not a defect in this test. tests/conftest_mocks.py line 35 stubs psycopg2 into sys.modules whenever it has not already been imported -- which at conftest time is always, even when the real library IS installed. So a DB test can never obtain a real connection. Releasing this needs that stub made conditional (importlib.util.find_spec), which changes the import environment for all 4,000+ tests and is its own change with its own blast radius.
entries.note: Still the highest-value entry. This is the gate that enforces extract -> tag -> verify coverage -> THEN enable an LGA, and 13 councils with zero provisions are live. It is now one well-scoped infrastructure fix away from running, rather than an unexplained SyntaxError.

entries.cause: The fixture file it loads at import time is not in the repository. Either commit the fixture or make the load lazy and skip when absent. MEASURED 2026-08-09: this file targets a local HTTP server (localhost:3007 or :3003) that CI does not start. It is a genuine integration test, not a broken unit test. The honest end state is a skip guard plus an integration marker so it is visible and runnable on demand -- not deletion, and not silent exclusion.
